description: The same interleaved text+span+text as mixed-inline-default, narrowed from 300px to 90px so the paragraph wraps across several lines, with the inline span landing wherever it falls in the wrapped flow — proof the real inline formatting context wraps a mixed run correctly, not just plain text.
